_readme: INACTIVE / RESEARCH registry. These entries are NOT loaded by the application and never appear in the model selectors, the Models page or the CLI. They were moved here (October 2026) because they cannot perform valid inference today: no usable weights exist, or the published artefact is in an unsupported format. Nothing here is deleted - the provenance, dataset links and blockers are preserved for future work. To reactivate an entry, obtain or train compatible weights, place them under models/<path>, and move the entry into models/custom/registry.json. BlueEye never fabricates weights, so an entry stays inactive until a real checkpoint exists.

models.name: Freshwater Fish (India)
models.license: Dataset CC BY 4.0; weights to be trained by us
models.summary: Freshwater pond / river fish for Karnataka and South India.
models.status_note: No trustworthy pretrained Indian freshwater-fish detector was found; train it and register the weights. Blocker (Oct 2026): the DePondFi files are not served by Mendeley's public API and its 'Download All' is disabled, so the annotations are not yet obtainable.

models.name: Gangetic River Dolphin
models.source: No public pretrained weights found; needs a locally annotated dataset
models.summary: Platanista gangetica surfacing in large Indian rivers.
models.status_note: No public pretrained model exists; the Gangetic dolphin is Endangered and survey imagery must be collected.

models.name: Freshwater Turtle (India)
models.source: No public pretrained weights found; needs a locally annotated dataset
models.summary: Freshwater turtles (roofed, flapshell, softshell) in Indian water bodies.
models.status_note: The MegaFauna model only has a broad 'turtle' class (mostly marine); a freshwater-specific model must be trained.

models.name: Gharial
models.source: No public pretrained weights found; needs a locally annotated dataset
models.summary: Gavialis gangeticus, typically basking on river banks.
models.status_note: No public pretrained gharial detector exists; Chambal / Girwa survey imagery is required.

models.name: Indian Coastal Species
models.source: Dataset: Underwater Species Dataset NR (Mendeley DOI 10.17632/4tp83br92z.1)
models.license: Dataset CC BY 4.0; weights to be trained by us
models.summary: Species-level coastal model for whale shark, octopus, rays and Olive Ridley turtles.
models.status_note: Octopus is not covered by any built-in model. Blocker (Oct 2026): the published Mendeley archive (96.7 MB RAR) contains 1,728 images but NO YOLO label files, so it cannot be trained on as-is.

models.name: Aquarium (Axera NPU export)
models.summary: Aquarium detector published only as Axera NPU (.axmodel) files.
models.description: No PyTorch .pt checkpoint is published for this model.
models.status_note: Cannot run here: only Axera NPU (.axmodel) exports are published, not an Ultralytics .pt checkpoint.
